title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Ichigo's New Blood Chain Bankai Form in Visual and Video
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 revealed a new visual and video to show Ichigo’s new “blood chain” form. The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Jumps to First Place in Week 7 of Summer 2026 Anime Ranking After Episode 13
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 took the top in the Summer 2026 anime ranking after Episode 13 in Week 7. This is the anime’s first win this season, having placed second in the previous week after the debut of its second part The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: Duel Masters Lost: Danzai no Shōnen Anime Reveals October 9 Debut
content: The website for the Duel Masters LOST anime series revealed a visual and October 9 debut on Saturday for the anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy). The new anime will have four episodes, and will stream on the Duel Masters official YouTube channel and other services.
author: ANN

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! TV Anime Reveals October 3 Debut in Main Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the main promotional video and October 3 debut for the anime on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Previews Wolf vs Gyobu Battle in New Teaser Trailer
content: The upcoming SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT theatrical anime revealed a new teaser trailer featuring the battle between Wolf and Gyobu Masataka Oniwa. The anime will begin a three-week limited theatrical run in Japan on September 4, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: 5 Things That Happen in Every Godzilla Movie (And Some Fans Don’t Want to Admit #1)
content: Since his feature film debut in 1954, Godzilla has not only become the most iconic big-screen monster of all time but also one of the most malleable characters to grace the silver screen. In his more than seventy-year history, Godzilla has been reworked and redefined in a variety of different ways .
